Non-surgical · PDO threads

Breast Thread Procedures: Uses & Limitations

Thread procedures use medical sutures placed in tissue for specific intended effects. Different thread materials, designs and placement techniques have different indications and limitations.

Home/Non-surgical/PDO threads

Understanding thread-based procedures

Thread-based procedures are not, on current evidence, a predictable alternative to breast surgery. Threads should not be presented as established substitutes for breast augmentation.

Potential risks include infection, discomfort, visible or palpable threads, asymmetry, thread migration or extrusion, and the need for corrective treatment. Suitability depends on the precise product, intended use, clinician competence and applicable regulations.
